A clear maintenance routine

Waterless does not mean maintenance-free. Give your team a documented routine and a clear way to report problems.

Routine cleaning

Follow the current manufacturer’s cleaning instructions for the installed model. Confirm product compatibility before use. Do not improvise chemical mixtures or cleaning methods.

Inspection and replacement

Check for slow drainage, damage and persistent odour. Record observations and arrange replacement of compatible consumables according to manufacturer guidance and actual use. There is no universal replacement interval stated here.

When something changes

Record the fixture location, symptoms, recent cleaning products and last service date. Ask your maintenance provider to assess drainage and the odour-control component. Repairs and plumbing work should be handled by qualified personnel.
